title: Diagnostic JSON pass for editorial slop
description:
**Phase 2 of MVP** under `PPY-54055d`.

## Intent

As a publication operator **or an agent**, I want to **run** a diagnose-only slop pass on a draft and get structured findings, so I can see what needs changing and steer which problems to skip, delete, or send to an LLM for rewrite options.

## Done when

- There is a **runnable tool** (same `papyrus` CLI verb for humans and agents) that takes a draft + style profile and prints or writes versioned diagnostic JSON. The draft is not modified.
- Output is **structured JSON only** (no prose rewrite): document_intent, audience, generic_passages, unsupported_claims, repetition_groups, voice_observations, required_facts.
- Detects at least: vague claims, empty lead-ins, uniform cadence, list-shaped prose, unsupported certainty, redundancy, voice mismatch vs style profile.
- Schema is automation-friendly and versioned.
- Each finding has a stable id so a human or agent can record skip / rewrite / delete / keep / add without a whole-document rewrite.
- This is editorial slop (quality findings), not an AI-detector score.

## Out of scope

Rewriting the draft in this pass. Generating rewrite options (that is Phase 3, and only for findings marked rewrite). Newsroom UI can come later; the CLI is the shared agent/human surface.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Diagnostic JSON pass for editorial slop
  As a publication operator or agent
  I want to run a diagnose command on a draft against a style profile
  So I can see what needs changing and steer findings without rewriting the article in this pass

  Scenario: Diagnose a draft without rewriting it
    Given a draft file and a loadable style profile
    When I run the diagnose command
    Then it writes versioned JSON with document_intent, audience, generic_passages, unsupported_claims, repetition_groups, voice_observations, and required_facts
    And each finding has a stable id
    And the findings cover vague claims, empty lead-ins, uniform cadence, list-shaped prose, unsupported certainty, redundancy, and voice mismatch
    And the result does not include rewritten prose
    And the draft file is unchanged

  Scenario: Findings are a steering queue
    Given diagnostic JSON from a completed diagnose pass
    When an operator or agent records skip, rewrite, delete, or keep against a finding id
    Then later option generation can address only the findings marked rewrite
```
